{
  "id": "aa3ji5kap6lei6aa3-algeria",
  "word": "阿爾及利亞",
  "jyutping": "aa3 ji5 kap6 lei6 aa3",
  "meaning": "Algeria",
  "pos": [
    "noun"
  ],
  "usage": [
    "阿爾及利亞係一個國家名，屬於非洲。",
    "呢個詞喺句中作名詞用，例如：我下一年想去阿爾及利亞旅行。",
    "可以用黎講述阿爾及利亞嘅地理、文化或者政治狀況。",
    "喺提及唔同國家嘅時候，可以用阿爾及利亞嚟代表呢個北非國家。",
    "阿爾及利亞嘅讀音同拼音要準確，方便理解同溝通。"
  ],
  "examples": [
    {
      "id": "aa3ji5kap6lei6aa3-algeria-example-1",
      "sentence": "阿爾及利亞今年天氣幾好。",
      "jyutping": "aa3 ji5 kap6 lei6 aa3 gam1 nin4 tin1 hei3 gei2 hou2.",
      "meaning": "Algeria's weather is quite good this year."
    },
    {
      "id": "aa3ji5kap6lei6aa3-algeria-example-2",
      "sentence": "我想了解阿爾及利亞嘅文化。",
      "jyutping": "ngo5 soeng2 liu5 gaai2 aa3 ji5 kap6 lei6 aa3 ge3 man4 faa3.",
      "meaning": "I want to learn about Algeria's culture."
    },
    {
      "id": "aa3ji5kap6lei6aa3-algeria-example-3",
      "sentence": "你去過阿爾及利亞未？",
      "jyutping": "nei5 heoi3 gwo3 aa3 ji5 kap6 lei6 aa3 mei6?",
      "meaning": "Have you been to Algeria?"
    },
    {
      "id": "aa3ji5kap6lei6aa3-algeria-example-4",
      "sentence": "阿爾及利亞係非洲最大嘅國家之一。",
      "jyutping": "aa3 ji5 kap6 lei6 aa3 hai6 fei1 zau1 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 gwok3 gaa1 zi1 jat1.",
      "meaning": "Algeria is one of the largest countries in Africa."
    }
  ],
  "audio": {
    "word": "aa3ji5kap6lei6aa3-algeria.mp3",
    "examples": [
      "aa3ji5kap6lei6aa3-algeria-example-1.mp3",
      "aa3ji5kap6lei6aa3-algeria-example-2.mp3",
      "aa3ji5kap6lei6aa3-algeria-example-3.mp3",
      "aa3ji5kap6lei6aa3-algeria-example-4.mp3"
    ]
  },
  "tags": [
    "country",
    "Africa",
    "travel",
    "geography",
    "culture",
    "level-1"
  ],
  "related": [
    "埃及",
    "摩洛哥",
    "突尼斯",

  ]
}

    }
